notes: The built-in emulator now works on Android too! Play Game Boy / Color / Advance games (Red through Emerald) right inside PokeTracker on your phone — with on-screen touch controls, hardware controller support, sound + volume, selectable fast-forward, and free rotation (portrait and landscape). Saves are written next to your ROM, so the auto-tracker reads them. Windows and Android now share the same built-in player.
